yaml:
name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - master
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - master

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Erlang
        uses: erlef/setup-beam@v1
        with:
          otp-version: "26.2"
          rebar3-version: "3.22.1"

      - name: Run tests
        run: rebar3 eunit ct

      - name: Determine repo and branch for nova_request_app
        id: vars
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "pull_request" ]; then
            # For PRs, check if it's from a fork
            FORK_REPO="${{ github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name }}"
            if [ "$FORK_REPO" != "${{ github.repository }}" ]; then
              echo "repo=$FORK_REPO" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            else
              echo "repo=${{ github.repository }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            fi
            echo "branch=${{ github.event.pull_request.head.ref }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          else
            # For direct pushes
            echo "repo=${{ github.repository }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "branch=${{ github.ref_name }}" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Run nova_request_app CI
        uses: novaframework/nova_request_app/.github/workflows/run_nra.yml@main
        with:
          branch: ${{ steps.vars.outputs.branch }}
          nova_repo: ${{ steps.vars.outputs.repo }}
